description.zh: 在 配音 标签里录下你自己的台词，用 Seed-VC 转换成允许的音色，再渲染与转换后的台词口型同步的镜头。
description.en: Record your own lines in a Voice tab, convert each take into an allowed voice with Seed-VC, and render shots lip-synced to the converted take.

setup.zh: 转换需要在有 NVIDIA GPU 的机器上运行 Seed-VC 服务器，并在 profile 补丁里打开 dv-seed-vc 和允许的音色；录音不需要服务器。
setup.en: Converting needs the Seed-VC server running on a machine with an NVIDIA GPU, and dv-seed-vc switched on with the allowed voices in the profile patch; recording works without it.

description.zh: 连接你自己的 Blender：在 Blender 标签和画布上实时查看它的视口，让智能体读取场景、在其中运行 Python、查看视口，并把静帧和动画渲染进项目。
description.en: Connect your own Blender: watch its viewport live in a Blender tab and on the canvas, and let the agent read the scene, run Python in it, look at the viewport, and render stills and animations into the project.

setup.zh: 需要 Blender 4.2 或更高版本，并安装 Blender 标签提供下载的 DreamVerse 插件；Blender 可以在你的电脑上，也可以和 harness 在同一台机器上，不需要服务器。
setup.en: Needs Blender 4.2 or later with the DreamVerse add-on, which the Blender tab offers to download; Blender can run on your computer or on the harness's machine, and no server is needed.
